about: Synthetic demo inbox for a CNC precision shop. All companies, people, part numbers, and addresses are fictional. 'expected' is the answer key used for the accuracy check; Jev never sees it.

emails.subject: RFQ 26-0412: Sensor mounting bracket, 6061-T6
emails.body:
Hi team,

Please quote the attached sensor mounting bracket, P/N QA-41127 Rev B.

Material: 6061-T6 aluminum
Finish: Black anodize per MIL-A-8625 Type II, Class 2
Quantities: 25 / 50 / 100
Inspection: standard, FAI on the first lot

Quote due by October 3. Let me know if you have any questions on the tolerances.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Buyer, Quillon Aerospace

expected.note: Simple prismatic bracket, full info, anodize is outside processing.

emails.subject: Quote request: Ti-6Al-4V instrument housing, prototypes
emails.body:
Hello,

We're developing a new laparoscopic instrument and need 6 prototype housings machined from Ti-6Al-4V ELI. The part has sculpted ergonomic surfaces and several compound-angle ports, so I expect it will need 5-axis work.

Drawing and STEP model attached. Please send pricing and lead time for 6 pcs, plus an estimate for a follow-on lot of 50 pcs. ISO 13485 certs required.

Thanks,
Marcus Hale
Mechanical Engineering Lead, Brightwater Medical

expected.note: Sculpted titanium medical part with compound angles.

emails.subject: RFQ: pump shaft HPV-3310, annual volume
emails.body:
Morning,

Requesting a quote on the attached pump shaft, HPV-3310 Rev C. 303 stainless, ground bearing journals, passivate per ASTM A967.

Release quantity is 500 pcs with an estimated annual usage of 6,000 pcs. Please show any tooling or NRE as a separate line.

We need the quote back within two weeks.

Greg Lindqvist
Purchasing Manager, Halvorsen Pump & Valve

expected.note: Round shaft, production volume, passivation.

emails.subject: RFQ SCD-7781: gimbal yoke, ITAR controlled

Mesa Ridge team,

The technical data package is ITAR controlled and is available only to U.S. persons through our secure supplier portal:
https://suppliers.sablecreekdefense.com/rfq/SCD-7781

Please include your ITAR registration number with your quote. Quote due in 10 business days.

Dana Whitcomb
Subcontracts Administrator, Sable Creek Defense Systems

expected.note: Explicit ITAR, drawings behind a U.S.-persons portal.

emails.subject: Request for quote: lens cell TO-5520
emails.body:

Owen Marsh
Supply Chain, Tessaract Optics
